units.source_text: 黑99对中央白虎的刺，白100粘。

en.t: Black 99 peeped at White's large central group, and White 100 connected.

units.source_text: 在箱根的最后一天，名人只下了这一手。

en.t: On the last day in Hakone, the Meijin played only this one move.

units.source_text: 终局之后，名人讲评说：“白100，虽说是在病重住院前夕，

en.t: After the game ended, the Meijin commented, "As for White 100, although it was played on the eve of my hospitalization for a serious illness,

units.source_text: 封棋前下的一手棋，也未免有点考虑不周。

en.t: and just before the sealed move, it was still somewhat ill-considered.

units.source_text: 这里应该脱先，应在‘18·十二’位挡，

en.t: Here I should have played elsewhere, blocking at the '18-12' point,

units.source_text: 以此巩固右下角的白空。

en.t: thereby strengthening White's territory in the lower right corner.
Since Black had peeped, Black would inevitably cut.
Even if White were cut, it would not be so painful.

units.source_text: 倘使白100固守地域，黑子形势恐怕也不容乐观。”

en.t: If White 100 had firmly defended the territory, Black's position probably would not have looked optimistic either."

units.source_text: 但是，白100不是坏棋，也不是由于这手才把形势破坏的。

en.t: However, White 100 was not a bad move, nor was it this move that spoiled the position.

units.source_text: 大竹七段和第三者也都看出名人当然要下这手棋。

en.t: Otake 7-dan and the other observers also understood that the Meijin would naturally play this move.
